type-plus.expression: (function(){const inputs=[...document.querySelectorAll('input')]; const sl=inputs[3]; sl.focus(); const setter=Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLInputElement.prototype,'value').set; setter.call(sl,'+15'); sl.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true})); sl.dispatchEvent(new Event('change',{bubbles:true})); return JSON.stringify({slValue:sl.value, all:inputs.map((i)=>i.value)});})()
